title: The Atria outpost, step 1 of 3: one Outpost Kit bought at Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140, lawless) and stored at Node Beta, six jumps from Atria on the north road
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-18 00:20 UTC; switched on 2026-11-22 04:05 UTC (orders.log ENT-061, block APOLLO and P3: found Atria, the builder holds the kit's credits; requests.log ENT-326: six flagships gave the builder 120,500 cr, the treasury pays the founding fee). Behind requires.ask: Ironlight Crossroads listed no Outpost Kit in its book of 2026-11-22 03:45 UTC (asks on record: 216,825 x 1 on 11-15, 74,010 x 3 on 11-16, 148,663 x 1 on 11-17, none on 11-21 19:33 and 11-22 03:45; the one other ask read is 999,999 x 18 at Arneb), so the route opens only when a docked reader of ours sees a kit there at 148,663 or less (150,150 with the buyer's 1 percent, the allocation) within 180 minutes, and no trip of 12 jumps goes to an empty book. min_credits 152,000 and max_pilots 1 keep it to the builder that holds the allocation (no other hauler holds over 51,000). Step 2: found.py from Node Beta, 6 jumps by Schedar, GSC-0050, Brachium, Nightveil, Acrab to Atria; step 3: the bunker by route.
